content.user_title: Manage CAPA Investigations and Action Plans
content.value_statement: Quality teams need consistent CAPA records that connect evidence, root causes, actions, and effectiveness checks. This skill guides CAPA work from intake through closure.
actual_capabilities: Maps CAPA work from initiation through effectiveness verification.
Selects RCA methods such as 5 Whys, fishbone, fault tree, human factors, and FMEA.
Drafts corrective, preventive, containment, and verification action plans with owners and milestones.
Defines CAPA metrics for cycle time, recurrence, overdue actions, and investigation quality.
Connects CAPA work to ISO 13485, FDA QSR, EU MDR, risk management, and inspections.
limitations: Does not include working CAPA automation scripts in this package.
Does not replace qualified regulatory, clinical, or quality leadership review.
Requires current procedure, incident, audit, and product context from the user.
Cannot verify data inside an external QMS unless the user provides it.

use_cases.title: Open a CAPA Investigation
use_cases.description: Draft the initial CAPA record, scope, containment actions, and investigation plan for a quality issue.

use_cases.title: Prepare Inspection-Ready Evidence
use_cases.description: Review CAPA records for root cause logic, action traceability, and effectiveness verification gaps.

use_cases.title: Resolve Recurring Process Issues
use_cases.description: Analyze repeated nonconformances and convert findings into corrective and preventive action plans.

prompt_templates.title: Start a CAPA Record
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new issue.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me open a CAPA for [issue]. Ask for missing context. Then draft the problem statement, scope, containment, and initial risk assessment.

prompt_templates.title: Choose an RCA Method
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare RCA methods for [issue]. Recommend one primary method and one supporting method. Explain what evidence each method needs.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Action Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request after root cause review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this verified root cause: [root cause]. Draft containment, corrective, preventive, and verification actions with owners, dates, and success criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Review CAPA System Trends
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for quality system oversight.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these CAPA metrics: [metrics]. Identify systemic trends, likely process weaknesses, overdue risks, and management review recommendations.

output_examples.input: A complaint trend shows repeated seal failures across two product lots.
output: Problem statement: Seal failures increased across two lots and may indicate a process control gap.
Recommended RCA method: Fishbone analysis supported by process data review.
Immediate action: Quarantine affected lots and verify current sealing parameters.

output_examples.input: The root cause is an outdated work instruction for inspection sampling.
output: Corrective action: Revise the work instruction and document approval.
Preventive action: Add periodic sampling plan review to document control.
Effectiveness check: Audit five completed inspections after training is complete.

output_examples.input: Quarterly CAPA metrics show high overdue rates and repeated recurrence.
output: Trend: Timeliness and recurrence metrics suggest weak ownership and verification planning.
Escalation: Review overdue CAPAs in management review.
Improvement: Add milestone reviews and stronger closure evidence requirements.

best_practices: Provide evidence, dates, owners, affected products, and process boundaries before asking for action plans.
Separate containment, corrective action, preventive action, and effectiveness verification.
Tie each action to a verified root cause and a measurable success criterion.
anti_patterns: Treating symptoms as root causes without testing evidence.
Closing CAPAs before effectiveness data covers the defined monitoring period.
Using generic training as the only action when process controls also failed.

faq.question: Can this skill create a full CAPA record?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft the main sections when you provide issue details, evidence, owners, dates, and constraints.

faq.question: Does it make regulatory decisions?
faq.answer: No. It supports documentation and reasoning, but qualified quality and regulatory leaders must approve final decisions.

faq.question: Which RCA methods does it support?
faq.answer: It supports 5 Whys, fishbone, fault tree, human factors analysis, and FMEA selection guidance.

faq.question: Can it analyze CAPA metrics?
faq.answer: Yes. It can interpret cycle time, recurrence, overdue rate, and investigation quality trends from user-provided data.

faq.question: Does this package include working scripts?
faq.answer: No. The included script, reference, and asset files are placeholders and do not provide working CAPA automation.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
